name: Insider Conviction
blurb: Companies whose own officers and directors bought stock on the open market with their own money — SEC Form 4 transaction code "P" only. Grants and option exercises are compensation and are excluded, which is the whole point: insiders sell for a hundred reasons and buy for one. These are mandatory public disclosures, not a claim that anything improper occurred. Priced from when each book actually became public rather than quarter-end, it returned +3.4% against the S&P's -0.0% since 2026-05-15.
